headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC welcomes NFRA announcement supporting mainland insurers to invest in Hong Kong ETFs via Stock Connect
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 18 - The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) welcomes the National Financial Regulatory Administration’s (NFRA) announcement today that it actively supports the participation of mainland insurance funds in the connectivity between the mainland and Hong Kong financial markets, and supports mainland insurance institutions in investing in Hong Kong exchange-traded funds (ETFs) via the Shanghai-Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect. This policy will further enrich the options for mainland insurance institutions to allocate overseas assets through Hong Kong, reflecting the NFRA’s support for continuously deepening financial connectivity between the mainland and Hong Kong. SFC Chairman Dr. Kelvin Wong said: 'We sincerely thank the NFRA for its long-standing firm support for the development of Hong Kong’s capital market and the financial connectivity between the mainland and Hong Kong. headlines.title: 国家金融监管总局支持内地险资经沪深港通买香港ETF
headlines.summary: 国家金融监督管理总局党委委员、副局长肖远企会见香港财经事务及库务局局长许正宇一行，肖远企表示，金融监管总局支持内地保险资金参与内地与香港金融市场互联互通，支持内地保险机构通过沪深港通投资香港的交易所买卖基金(ETF)。 香港财政司司长陈茂波表示，开放内地保险资金通过沪深港通投资香港ETF，是互利多赢的举措，既可为内地保险公司提供更广阔多元的投资渠道，亦带动香港交易所买卖产品市场的发展，更进一步深化两地资本市场的连繫和联动发展。

headlines.title_en: NFRA supports mainland insurers' investment in Hong Kong ETFs via Stock Connect
headlines.summary_en: Xiao Yuanqi, Member of the Party Committee and Deputy Administrator of the National Financial Regulatory Administration, met with a delegation led by Christopher Hui, Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury of Hong Kong. Xiao Yuanqi stated that the NFRA supports mainland insurance funds in participating in the connectivity between mainland and Hong Kong financial markets, and supports mainland insurance institutions in investing in Hong Kong exchange-traded funds (ETFs) via the Shanghai-Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect. Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan said that opening up mainland insurance funds to invest in Hong Kong ETFs via the Stock Connect is a mutually beneficial move, providing mainland insurers with broader and more diversified investment channels, driving the development of Hong Kong’s exchange-traded products market, and further deepening the connection and coordinated development of the two capital markets.

headlines.summary: 今年以来，中国进出口银行充分发挥政策性金融职能作用，加大资源倾斜力度，全力支持制造业高质量发展，助力构建以先进制造业为骨干的现代化产业体系。今年1—7月，中国进出口银行新发放制造业贷款近5000亿元，重点支持了传统产业转型升级、新兴产业发展壮大、未来产业提前布局等领域，其中先进制造业贷款近2000亿元，占比40%。 (央视新闻)

headlines.title_en: China Exim Bank issued nearly RMB 500 billion in new manufacturing loans in the first seven months
headlines.summary_en: Since the start of this year, the Export-Import Bank of China has leveraged its policy finance role, increased resource allocation, and fully supported high-quality manufacturing development, helping build a modern industrial system led by advanced manufacturing. From January to July this year, the bank issued nearly 500 billion yuan in new manufacturing loans, focusing on areas such as traditional industry transformation and upgrading, emerging industry growth, and forward-looking layout of future industries, of which advanced manufacturing loans totaled nearly 200 billion yuan, accounting for 40%. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: Xiaomi Group: Smart EV revenue at RMB 23.9 billion
headlines.summary_en: Xiaomi Group stated that in the second quarter of 2026, its smart electric vehicle (EV) and AI and other innovative business segment recorded revenue of RMB 24.9 billion, up 17.1% year-on-year. Among this, smart EV revenue was RMB 23.9 billion, and other related business revenue was RMB 1 billion (including AI business revenue from the Xiaomi MiMo large model series). In this quarter, the gross margin for the smart EV and AI and other innovative business segment was 19.2%. In the second quarter of 2026, the operating loss for the smart EV and AI and other innovative business segment was RMB 2.6 billion.

headlines.title: 国务院：住房公积金的存、贷利率由国务院决定
headlines.summary: 国务院发布关于修改《住房公积金管理条例》的决定。修改内容包括，将第六条修改为：“住房公积金的存、贷利率由国务院决定。”将第二十八条第一款中的“可以将住房公积金用于购买国债”修改为“可以将住房公积金用于购买国债和政策性金融债”。

headlines.title_en: State Council: Housing provident fund deposit and loan rates determined by the State Council
headlines.summary_en: The State Council issued a decision on amending the “Regulations on the Administration of Housing Provident Funds.” The amendments include changing Article 6 to: “The deposit and loan interest rates of housing provident funds shall be determined by the State Council.” In the first paragraph of Article 28, “housing provident funds may be used to purchase government bonds” is amended to “housing provident funds may be used to purchase government bonds and policy-oriented financial bonds.”

headlines.title_en: China Unicom: 2026 H1 net profit RMB 4.139 billion, down 34.8% YoY
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 18 - China Unicom announced that first-half 2026 revenue was RMB 20.136 billion, up 0.6% year-on-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was RMB 4.139 billion, down 34.8% year-on-year; non-GAAP net profit was RMB 3.534 billion, down 36.7% year-on-year. Basic earnings per share were RMB 0.133. The company will not distribute an interim dividend.

headlines.title_en: A-share close: Beijing Stock Exchange 50 Index up 2.67%; agricultural stocks surge broadly
headlines.summary_en: 1. Markets hit lows and recovered throughout the day, with the three major indices mixed. Agricultural stocks surged collectively, with nearly 20 stocks including Shennong Seed, Dunhuang Seed, and Nongfa Seed hitting limit-up. IT innovation concept rallied in the afternoon, with stocks like Cmest, Kylinsec, China Software, and Dongfang Zhongke hitting limit-up. Oil and gas concepts were active, with Sinopec Oilfield Equipment hitting limit-up. On the downside, computing power leasing concept corrected, with Chengdixiangjiang hitting limit-down; film and TV stocks fell, with Beijing Culture down over 9%. Decliners outnumbered advancers, with over 3,200 stocks falling across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing exchanges, with turnover at 2.42 trillion yuan. By close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.19%, the Shenzhen Component fell 0.56%, and the ChiNext fell 0.93%. 2. headlines.title_en: Southbound capital sees net inflow of RMB 14.002 billion today
headlines.summary_en: Southbound capital saw net buying of RMB 14.002 billion today. On the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect (SH-HK), Tracker Fund and Alibaba-W recorded net purchases of HKD 2.519 billion and HKD 2.282 billion respectively; the top net selling was HKD 404 million. On the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect (SZ-HK), Tracker Fund and SMIC recorded net purchases of HKD 989 million and HKD 573 million respectively; Tencent Holdings saw the largest net selling of HKD 374 million.

headlines.summary: 中国联通在港交所公告：2026上半年收入表现稳健，在行业整体增长面临挑战的情况下，营业收入人民币2,014亿元，同比提升0.6%；受增值税及人工成本投入节奏变化影响，盈利短期承压，预计全年利润降幅将明显收窄，2026上半年净利润人民币95亿元，同比下降34.6%。算力收入人民币419亿元，同比增长13%，其中智算中心收入同比增长11%，智能计算收入同比增长9%。

headlines.title_en: China Unicom (H-share): H1 2026 revenue RMB 201.4 billion; computing power revenue RMB 41.9 billion, up 13% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: China Unicom announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange: First-half 2026 revenue was stable, with operating revenue of RMB 201.4 billion, up 0.6% year-on-year, despite challenges in overall industry growth. Profitability faced short-term pressure due to changes in VAT and labor cost investment timing, with full-year profit decline expected to narrow significantly. First-half 2026 net profit was RMB 9.5 billion, down 34.6% year-on-year. Computing power revenue was RMB 41.9 billion, up 13% year-on-year, with intelligent computing center revenue up 11% and intelligent computing revenue up 9%.

headlines.title_en: Bekewei: 2026 H1 net profit between RMB 100.3 million and RMB 108.01 million, up about 30%-40% YoY
headlines.summary_en: Beck Micron (02149.HK) announced that for the six months ended June 30, 2026, it recorded revenue in the range of RMB 321 million to RMB 336 million, up approximately 10% to 15% year-on-year; and recorded net profit in the range of RMB 100.3 million to RMB 108 million, up approximately 30% to 40% year-on-year. The expected revenue and net profit growth during the reporting period is mainly due to the continued growth in replacement demand for high-end analog chips, with the company leveraging its long-accumulated high-quality industrial product portfolio to continuously serve core customers in the broad industrial sector. As the product portfolio steadily expands, the company’s market share in the high-end industrial analog chip segment is gradually increasing; and benefiting from its machine-learning-based semi-automated chip design methodology, its self-developed R&D platform continues to release cost advantages and efficiency gains in the design stage. headlines.title: 群核科技增资至16.91亿
headlines.summary: 天眼查App显示，近日，杭州群核信息技术有限公司发生工商变更，注册资本由约14.91亿人民币增至约16.91亿人民币。杭州群核信息技术有限公司成立于2011年11月，法定代表人为黄晓煌，经营范围包括信息技术咨询服务、货物进出口、技术进出口、技术服务、技术开发、技术咨询、技术交流、技术转让、技术推广等。

headlines.title_en: Qunhe Technology increases registered capital to RMB 1.691 billion
headlines.summary_en: Tianyancha App shows that Hangzhou Qunhe Information Technology Co., Ltd. recently underwent a business registration change, with registered capital increasing from approximately 1.491 billion yuan to approximately 1.691 billion yuan. Hangzhou Qunhe Information Technology Co., Ltd. was established in November 2011, with legal representative Huang Xiaohuang, and its business scope includes IT consulting services, goods import/export, technology import/export, technical services, development, consulting, exchange, transfer, and promotion.
